overall_summary: View counts across all 12 videos are exceptionally low (ranging from 5 to 36 views), indicating low statistical significance and early-stage audience discovery. However, content focused on 'self respect' and tangible smartphone actions (like deleting chats or removing numbers) slightly outperformed abstract late-night themes.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'चैट डिलीट करने की हिम्मत' (AfaLxMy6FMY) with 36 views and 'बिना नाम का नंबर' (aNR94Xxn0yM) with 24 views performed relatively better than abstract ones.
winning_patterns.action: Focus hooks around physical actions on a phone related to boundaries and self-respect.

weak_patterns.evidence: Openers like 'रात के दो बजे' (G0gKV1p3ZHc) and 'मेज पर रखी चाय ठंडी हो गई' (uIbMpCjVutQ) pulled lower views (5 to 12).
weak_patterns.action: Avoid starting purely with time-of-night or weather descriptions; anchor to a specific digital artifact instead.

next_video.concept: A short piece about turning off read receipts for just one specific person, realizing that peace matters more than them knowing you saw their message.
next_video.opening_direction: Blue ticks turned off just for one chat.
next_video.twist_direction: Realizing the true peace isn't hiding your status from them, but finally losing the urge to check if they noticed.
